home.culturalHeritageTitle: Carrying the Echoes of Our Ancestors
home.culturalHeritageDescription: Names are not just labels — they are living connections to where we come from. In Tamil culture, every name holds the rhythm of our language, the depth of our traditions, and the memory of our ancestors. These names carry stories of courage, compassion, and wisdom passed down through generations. They remind us that our heritage is not locked in the past but continues to live and breathe through the identities we carry today. To know a name is to honor a legacy, to cherish a culture, and to keep alive the timeless spirit of Tamil identity.
